alert.abeyrule: Execute If The Above Conditions Are Met
alert.actionhelperplaceholder: Enter a requirement, for example: show a warning dialog asking whether to generate an event. If confirmed, call an integration to create a ticket with the alert content and level, then show a success message.
alert.actiontypesubscribedesc: Subscriptions with an action type can be suppressed by suppression policies.
alert.addtimequantumtip: Please Add At Least One Time Quantum
alert.aggregateattrhelp: Aggregate variables can be used during aggregation. If a single alert attribute variable is used, the value of the last member in alertList is used by default.
alert.aggregatecontenthelp: Help: If empty, the default alert list is used. Available variables: ${DATA.alertCount}, ${DATA.alertList}, ${DATA.alertItemList}.
alert.aggregateenabledesc: When enabled, alerts are collected while the circuit breaker is open, and the event plugin aggregate-trigger entry point is called when the circuit breaker expires.
alert.aiagentduplicateattrerror: The same alert attribute cannot be mapped more than once
alert.aiagentinputtemplatedesc: Supports variables such as ${DATA.const_title} and ${DATA.attr_xxx}. When empty, the alert attributes JSON is used.
alert.aiagentnooutputfield: The alert event agent does not define output fields
alert.aiagentnotcreated: Create The Alert Event Agent First
alert.aiagentoutputmappingdesc: The agent returns only mapped fields. Output fields and alert attributes must have matching types.
alert.aiagentremovedattrerror: This alert attribute is missing or deleted. Select another attribute.
alert.aiagentremovedfielderror: This output field was removed. Select another field.
alert.aiagenttypemismatcherror: The output field and alert attribute types do not match
alert.aiagentunavailable: The alert event agent is missing, disabled, or its model is unavailable
alert.alertnotexists: Alert Does Not Exist Or Has Been Deleted
alert.alertsigndesc: Alert signature rules apply only to the related attribute.
alert.alertsignhelp: Help: Alert signatures apply regular-expression replacements to attribute values and then combine them into a unique key. Multiple alert signatures can be selected. Each signature applies only to its related attribute; it has no effect if that attribute is not part of the unique key.
alert.applychildalert: Apply To Child Alerts As Well
alert.assignhelp: Help: You can assign an alert to multiple users or groups. Assigned users and users in those groups can process the alert.
alert.atleastonerule: Please Add At Least One Rule
alert.atleastoneschedule: Add At Least One Schedule Configuration
alert.breakeropenactiontrigger: Trigger When The Circuit Breaker Opens
alert.breakeropenmailtitle: [Alert Center][Circuit Breaker Notification] The circuit breaker policy has been triggered
alert.breakerrecoveractiontrigger: Trigger When The Circuit Breaker Recovers
alert.breakerrecovermailtitle: [Alert Center][Circuit Breaker Recovery] The circuit breaker policy has recovered
alert.cancelintervalhelp: Select one or more scheduled plugins to cancel under the current alert type.
alert.closesameuniquekeyalert: Close All Alerts With The Same Unique Key
alert.collectlimitdesc: The maximum number of alerts collected while the circuit breaker is open. After the limit is reached, new alerts are not collected and only the discarded count is recorded.
alert.configureaiagentfirst: Please Configure The AI Agent First
alert.consecutivefailuresummary: {handler} counts by {scope}. After {failureThreshold} consecutive failures, the circuit breaker opens for {duration}.
alert.countwindowstatesummary: Collected {collectCount} alerts and skipped {dropCount} alerts beyond the limit{baselinePart}{collectLimitPart}.
alert.countwindowsummary: {handler} counts by {dimension}. After {threshold} triggers within {window}, the circuit breaker opens for {duration}. Aggregate triggering is {aggregate}{collectPart}.
alert.defaultmailserverhelp: Help: Leave empty to use the default mail server.
alert.defaultstatushelp: Help: The default status used when an alert event is created.
alert.deletematchconfirm: The current advanced search conditions match {count} alerts. Confirming will submit background deletion.
alert.deleteparentalertonly: Delete Parent Alert Only; Keep Child Alerts
alert.deletesubalerthelp: Delete all child alerts at the same time?
alert.dimensiondesc: The circuit breaker plugin generates a circuit breaker key from the selected dimensions and uses it to make circuit-breaking decisions. For example, when Plugin Instance is selected, the plugin determines whether to enter the open state based on the trigger count for each plugin instance.
alert.enumtypedesc: Enum values are saved automatically for enum types.
alert.failurethresholddesc: The circuit breaker opens when the latest consecutive-failure count reaches this value. Because the decision is made before plugin execution, the next trigger after the threshold is reached is blocked.

alert.mailreceiverthresholddesc: Aggregate circuit breaking starts when the same email-plugin instance and the same actual recipient list exceed this count within the statistics window.
alert.mailreceiverwindowstatesummary: Processing group {groupName} collected {alertCount} alerts and skipped {dropCount} alerts beyond the limit.
alert.mailreceiverwindowsummary: {handler} counts by recipient. After the same processing group triggers {threshold} times within {window}, aggregate circuit breaking starts and collects up to {collectLimit} alerts.
alert.maxsendhelp: Help: Leave empty or set to 0 for unlimited sends. Emails exceeding the send limit cannot be sent and will return an exception.
alert.maxsimilaralerthelp: Maximum number of similar alerts to return
alert.noalertmatched: No alerts match the current conditions.
alert.noindexdesc: Non-indexed attributes are not saved to ES.
alert.notifyintervalhelp: Help: A notification is sent only once within the notification interval (? minutes).
alert.notransferpluginmessage: If no plugin is provided, the alert content is not transformed. Content that does not conform to the standard format is discarded. Each alert type can use multiple transformation plugins for different sources; upload the corresponding plugin for each source.
alert.opensameuniquekeyalert: Open All Alerts With The Same Unique Key
alert.originretentionhelp: If unset, access records are not cleared automatically. The system clears only access records that did not generate alerts; records that generated alerts are deleted with those alerts.
alert.rebuildselectedalertindexconfirm: Confirming will submit a background task to rebuild the indexes of the selected alerts.
alert.recentalarmdatahelp: Search alert data from the last ? minutes. Enter 0 for no limit.
alert.schedulefinished: All scheduled jobs have been executed.
alert.scopedesc: When Plugin Instance is selected, each event-plugin configuration is counted separately. When Plugin Type is selected, plugins of the same type share the consecutive-failure count.
alert.searchrecentalarmdata: Search Alert Data From The Last {target} Minutes
alert.selectonereceiver: Please Select At Least One Recipient
alert.serialsavehelp: Help: Save alerts with the same unique key serially to avoid invalid parent-child relationships when they are saved concurrently.
alert.suppressionworktimedesc: If a service schedule is selected, the current policy is triggered only outside the scheduled service hours.
alert.thresholdcountwindowdesc: The circuit breaker opens when the trigger count in the statistics window exceeds this value.
alert.titleoptionaldesc: Some scenarios, such as SMS messages, may not have a title.
alert.topattrdesc: Top attributes can be used as top-level search conditions on the alert list page.
alert.topattrtooltip: Top attributes appear in the default result list and search conditions.
alert.transferpluginapidocprefix: Find The Transformation Plugin API Definition
alert.uniquealertconvergehelp: Help: Alerts with the same unique key are consolidated into one alert.
alert.vectorpluginhelp: This plugin stores alert semantic vectors when triggered and requires no configuration.
